releaseNotes:
Root cause of the "tap Vulkan GPU does nothing" reports on Samsung One UI
(S20 included): startActivityAndCollapse(Intent) throws
UnsupportedOperationException on API 34+ (targetSdk 34+), and the failure
was swallowed by a catch, so tile taps without a ready Shizuku backend
were absolute no-ops. Tiles now:

- launch Muimex11 through startActivityAndCollapse(PendingIntent) on
  API 34+ (Intent path kept for older), routed through unlockAndRun()
  when the device is locked
- toast every outcome: Private DNS on/off, Focus mode on/off,
  "Graphics API -> ... applies to newly launched apps" (Vulkan tile),
  or the copyable failure reason
- use res.ok from the shell call instead of assuming success, and
  tolerate updateTile() after the shade collapses mid-flight

Also audited the rest of the external entry surface (GraphicsBootReceiver,
TaskerReceiver w/ token guard, ScreenScheduleReceiver, battery alarm FGS):
no other API-34 crash paths or silent failures found. Bumps to 4.34 (code 64).
